skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply auditing practices in various settings including independent audit firms, government audit agencies, and internal audit departments.
Develop advanced research skills necessary for conducting comprehensive audits and analyzing financial statements.
Demonstrate knowledge of legal frameworks, accounting standards, and auditing regulations applicable in Vietnam.
Analyze and evaluate the outcomes of audits, drawing lessons from each audit process and internal control activities.
Adhere to ethical standards and professional conduct expected in the field of auditing.
